d: India is set to introduce polymer or plastic currency notes starting FY28. The Reserve Bank of India will initially roll out ₹10 and ₹20 polymer notes, which last two to four times longer than paper currency and are expected to reduce wear and tear. Meanwhile, Heavy monsoon rain once again brought traffic to a crawl across Delhi-NCR, with waterlogging disrupting roads and the IMD issuing multiple weather alerts. Similar scenes have unfolded in several Indian cities during this monsoon season. Hem Saroya tells you more.
